Find and destroy the gathering Am Fah bandits.
{{TOCright}}

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Seek out the Am Fah gathering in [[Bukdek Byway]] and eliminate them.
* See Guardsman Ping for your reward.

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 175 [[Gold]]
* [[Imperial Commendation]]

==Walkthrough==
After leaving from The Marketplace head east. You will encounter two groups of Am Fah after crossing the second of two bridges (at point 1 on the wiki map). Try to engage only one group at a time, but don't worry, if your party wipes you will be resurrected nearby. If you hug the left side of the bridge as you cross it you have a good chance to not aggro the second group. After defeating the two groups of Am Fah continue to head east. You will come into contact with two groups of Am Fah, with a more manageable placement, as well as a [[statue of Balthazar]] (point 2) that you can kneel in front of while Favor of the Gods is active to acquire Morale Boosts and blessings. After killing the Am Fah enter a small alcove to the east. Once inside you will encounter [[Chung, the Attuned]] (point 3). As  you approach Chung more enemies will drop from above, so be ready for a fight.

==Dialogue==

'''Guardsman Ping'''
:''"I have a job for you if you are interested. It seems the Am Fah have been growing bolder of late. Even now, a mob of them gathers in Bukdek Byway assaulting citizens there. The city guard is spread ever so thin by the plague. If you are looking for a fight, go to '''Bukdek Byway''' and deal with these '''Am Fah''' for us."''
